reviews.text:
Dr. Ana is a fantastic professional; she's the one who takes care of my cat, Monito 🦍. All the staff are very attentive, especially the assistant, Claudia.

Thank you to the whole team for their constant helpfulness!
Excellent service, friendly, professional staff, and flexible hours.
Very professional, and impeccable service, they answered any questions I had about my cats with spectacular kindness.

The service is very good, but the wait is ENDLESS. I've been at least 10 times (and for now, I'll continue to choose them), but the WAIT TIMES URGENTLY NEED IMPROVEMENT. Even if you make an appointment, you have to wait at least 45 minutes to 1.5 hours.

My cat was seriously ill with an infection and hospitalized. I took her to this clinic, and they saved her life. Now she's home with us, playing as usual. I highly recommend them. They're incredibly transparent, always writing to you and keeping you updated on everything happening with your pet, from whether they're eating and drinking water to their entire treatment process, and they document everything. I thank them from the bottom of my heart. It's heartbreaking to see your companions like that, and thanks to them, that suffering is over.

First time here. I took my dog ​​for her rabies vaccination and deworming. Excellent service, not a long wait, and a price lower than many other clinics. Plus, Diego found the right brand of vaccine that doesn't cause an allergic reaction in my little one. I'll be back in September for the other vaccination and blood tests for both of my dogs.

Excellent 👍🏼
Very friendly and professional. …
Thank you so much, Marta, for your fabulous attention, your friendliness, and your excellent work. We were very happy with you 🫶🏼
Very professional people, I highly recommend them.
Excellent veterinarian, empathetic, friendly, good prices 😻 …

Excellent veterinary clinic with highly experienced and caring doctors. The clinic is equipped with modern diagnostic equipment, and every visit has been professional and efficient.
Outstanding communication (also in English). The staff are easy to reach via WhatsApp and respond quickly, even on weekends, which provides great peace of mind when you are worried about your pet.
I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for excellent veterinary care for their animals.
Excellent professional and animal lover
Very attentive, quick and affectionate with pets
A very humane and professional team. Dr. Ana is a great veterinarian, and David, the assistant who's sometimes at the entrance, is very friendly and explains everything very well.
Excellent care and service. They gave me an appointment quickly. Professional in every way, and they were able to identify what was wrong with my cat. Very nice!
They were very attentive and kind to our pet. Super professional, clear, and direct with their diagnoses. Reasonable prices and the staff who work there are amazing!

A huge thank you to Ana and her entire team. They are absolutely wonderful, incredibly professional, friendly, and kind. We took our cat Abby in for an emergency visit, not knowing what was wrong with her. They performed the minimum necessary tests very quickly (ultrasound and blood work), and gave us an appointment for surgery in less than two weeks to remove her uterus and ovaries (which she needed). By the way, it's the only clinic in Valencia that's open on Sundays for non-emergency cases.
They kept us informed the whole time, which is so appreciated when it's your first time in this situation. Everything went perfectly. We picked her up that same day, and she's recovered so well that if it weren't for the scar, I'd think they hadn't done anything at all (better sutures than I've seen on some humans). Eternally grateful for their care of my furry friend (I know it wasn't easy for them because she's not very friendly with strangers). Hugs
Excellent attention and service. Great empathy for animals. I highly recommend her.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Juana
I went to the emergency room yesterday, Sunday, and it was great. I'm so glad I went and I'll definitely be using them again. The price was very affordable. 👋 …
I left my cat to be neutered when he was six months old, and they returned him to me dead. I should never have taken him to this vet.
Laura's service was fantastic. Absolutely excellent. We were delighted.

Excellent!!
The team is lovely! Vets Chiara and Ana are very accurate in their diagnoses. They do their work with so much love that my dog ​​Oliver was always calm (even though he's nervous). They were also able to cure him after he'd been to many vets with incorrect diagnoses. Thank you so much!!!
Coraima at reception is super friendly!
Highly recommended. Don't hesitate to bring your pet here!!
I am very happy with the way my pets are treated; they are super professional and very kind to them.
Excellent service and professionalism.
Excellent professionals. They took great care of our little dog, Papucho. Highly recommended!

We adopted two cats from a colony, with all that entails, and they were always safe thanks to Ana and her team, who gave us timely appointments and treated them with so much love!

Thank you so much!!
An excellent veterinary center; they treat your pet wonderfully, performing all the necessary tests to ensure your little one is healthy and strong again.

We couldn't be more grateful to Ana and all the professionals at the clinic ❤️ It was a Saturday in August at midday when we realized my cat had swallowed a piece of thread 🥲
They came to us after we called and operated on him within the next few hours. Thanks to their quick thinking, the thread didn't pass through his stomach, and they were able to remove it more safely 🙏🙏

They helped us during the post-operative period and answered all our questions. Now, 12 days later, Momo 🐱 is fully recovered, and we couldn't be happier with the care he received 😊

Thank you 💖
Our kitten was admitted with a complex condition. Dr. Ana and her team have treated Chuva with great professionalism and care, just as they have treated us. Thank you for your empathy.
My kitten had surgery and everything went perfectly. The service was excellent, they answered all our questions and were very helpful. I highly recommend this place.
As always, great service, with recommendations for my dog. Now it's best to make an appointment.

A clinic with highly qualified professionals dedicated to caring for our beloved pets. They treat them with great care and always provide the best treatment; they're not just in it for the money like some other centers. They offer extended hours and a full range of services, including lab tests, surgeries, ultrasounds, and more, all within the clinic.

They are my trusted veterinarians, even though I also have a vet through insurance, but I always go to them because they solve problems, understand them, and monitor my dog ​​closely. They're amazing. My dog ​​always has allergies, and every time he has one, I go to them, or even just to ask for advice.

My cat Exo is in the clinic for a urinary obstruction, and I believe he's in the best hands. The team is wonderful and professional, the care is excellent, and the hours are convenient. I highly recommend this clinic to everyone.
Excellent treatment of the furry ones. Very professional. My Mollo was very well cared for. Thank you.
Highly recommended veterinarian. They are highly professional and their rates are very affordable compared to other vets.
They are the best veterinarians and they care so much about animals.
Excellent and professional service, friendly and fast. Highly recommended; I've been taking my dogs here for years.
Every time I've been there, the service has been excellent, both towards me and my kittens.
An excellent attraction, good prices, and most importantly, the attention given to our pets who are like family.
Great doctors and administrators
Excellent, dedicated, attentive, and professional. My dog ​​is happy and healed.
The receptionist is unfriendly and gives inaccurate information, leaving things out. I'm not going back.
I've been taking my dog ​​there since she was 6 months old and they've always treated her incredibly well. It's been 8 years now and I wouldn't take her anywhere else; the vet is the best.

We took our dog Crema to be spayed, and it was a meticulous and well-planned procedure. The doctor was excellent and very clear in her communication and explanations. The rest of the staff was also very attentive and professional. If you take your pets there, you won't regret it.

We came to this clinic on a recommendation. First visit. Chiara attended to us. We left extremely happy with the excellent service and the price. I recommend it 100%! From now on, it will be our only veterinary clinic. A 10 out of 10!
It's a pleasure to take your furry friend there. Excellent service.

The comments from the head veterinarian were very inappropriate and showed a lack of sensitivity that shouldn't be expected of someone who works with animals. Naturally, the animals are scared because they're in an unfamiliar environment being vaccinated, operated on, etc., and are therefore stressed. The rest of the staff were very kind.
I didn't know them, they're a great discovery, 100% recommended.

Thank you for taking care of Basi and Duque.
Without a doubt, the best clinic in Campanar.

The best vet in Valencia offers quality and affordable prices, ideal for those of us with multiple pets who want quality service at a good price. They've always been incredibly helpful with all my animals; they're true professionals. I wouldn't go to another vet ever again.
Excellent service, highly recommended

I went there in the summer because my dog ​​was stung by a wasp on the snout, and they were incredibly kind. It was a weekend, and they didn't overcharge me; quite the opposite. They were very professional and attentive. They've now become my go-to vet.
The establishment provides good service, but I want to give a big thank you to María José for being patient with my pet, as she is very nervous; she managed to calm her down 👍🏻 …
Good professionals

I wanted to thank one of the staff members for the wonderful service I received.

She was a true professional and very friendly.

Thank you, Claudia. I highly recommend going there because of the friendly service and, above all, the exceptional attention I received from her.

For several years, we've taken my dog ​​for routine annual checkups (vaccinations and deworming) since he had fortunately been healthy until a few months ago when he started experiencing decreased tail mobility.
At first, they only gave him medication (corticosteroids and antibiotics) without performing any additional tests or a complete physical examination, despite this alarming symptom and its sudden onset.
Given the lack of improvement and the worsening of his symptoms, with progressive difficulty even walking in less than 24 hours, we contacted the veterinary clinic by phone several times. They told us they would call us back during the day to schedule an appointment, but we didn't receive that call until two days later. Frustrated by the lack of attention and desperate because of our dog's deteriorating condition, we decided to go to another veterinary clinic (Atalaya Veterinary Clinic) based on the good reviews we had read, and he was seen immediately. We were greeted by a very professional and caring team who were as concerned for our dog as they were for us. They performed a complete examination and urgent blood work, which quickly diagnosed him with a very aggressive lymphoma.
The treatment we received at the Montero Veterinary Clinic, which had been our trusted clinic for seven years, was an absolute disappointment. It's a shame to see how professionals who work with pets and their families sometimes treat them with such inhumanity and lack clinical acumen.
It's the best veterinary clinic I know. They're wonderful with the animals and their hours and prices are perfect.
Great professionals and staff. I highly recommend them. They demonstrate their knowledge and love for animals, and it's a pleasure to have my furry son Rocco as their patient.
On the 29th of this month, we took my cat Ojitos to be spayed. From the moment I walked in until I picked her up, the service was professional, and the operation was perfect. I'm glad I trusted them.

This clinic has changed a lot in the last eight years. Now the service is impersonal, and they just tell you to come back tomorrow and make an appointment, ignoring the warning signs we'd been pointing out. We insisted for several days that our beloved dog wasn't improving with the anti-inflammatories and corticosteroids, but they insisted it was "a bone problem." The last straw was a CT scan, a €600 test that was completely useless.
Desperate, we went to another vet in the neighborhood near Decathlon. We were amazed: quick, kind, and caring treatment for our dog and for us. The first thing they did was an examination, where they noticed the swollen lymph nodes. Then they ordered urgent blood work. In less than 24 hours, we had the sad diagnosis: lymphoma. Medone and company are probably just now finding out about their disastrous treatment and the outcome. Lymphoma is easy to diagnose with these two simple and basic tests: examination and blood work. It's basic. It's included in all veterinary protocols and manuals; in fact, the lymph nodes increase in size three to five times. But you have to think about it and rule it out, especially when your treatment is failing and the family is raising concerns. I wonder why he wasn't examined or tested, and why the new vet, who was seeing our dog for the first time, did that first. Our dog is gone. There wasn't time to save him because he needed chemotherapy and an accurate diagnosis, not anti-inflammatories. And he didn't get that at this clinic, where the assistants lack experience and the manager is preoccupied with other things. I don't know if I'll ever have another pet, but I know where I wouldn't take them even if it were free. In the meantime, we're going to consider reporting this situation for possible malpractice regarding errors in diagnosis and treatment.

**Edited review in response to the clinic's comment: To clarify the "context" mentioned.

1- Our cocker spaniel didn't improve at any point; on the contrary, he worsened day by day. In fact, in your request for the CT scan from the hospital, you mention that he wasn't improving with the different medications you administered. Remember that I'm on the copy.

2- The pathology was always the same: LYMPHOMA. All the symptoms were part of it; you just couldn't diagnose it correctly.

3- Les Alfabegues Hospital only performs the tests you request. No more, no less. If you hadn't requested blood work (which YOU should have done from the very beginning, in my opinion), they would have done it.

4- The CT scan report only confirms a minor lesion that didn't justify the pain. MILD. It's also stated in the report.

5- While we were wasting time waiting for the CT scan results, our beloved Doc was suffering and getting worse, so given your attitude and inaction, we decided to go to another veterinarian. The first thing they did was a simple lymph node examination (which you never did) and blood work (which you also didn't do). We had the results in less than 24 hours, and the lymphocyte, anemia, and platelet levels made it abundantly clear what was wrong: LYMPHOMA.

6- In addition, we simultaneously requested a neurological evaluation, ultrasound, and biopsies as deemed necessary, which you also failed to request from the hospital. These tests confirmed the diagnosis in detail: MULTICENTRIC LYMPHOMA, which you had always considered a musculoskeletal issue.

To conclude. I'm not a veterinarian, nor do I blame you for the lymphoma in my cocker spaniel, but I did notice that while another veterinarian performed a simple lymph node examination (1 minute) and a basic blood test that quickly explained why my dog ​​was failing, you, so busy with your 8,000+ pets and 35 years of experience, didn't have the time or the clinical eye to detect the disease with some simple tests. You wasted precious time that could have been used to start chemotherapy and try to save him, and above all, give him a better quality of life. Only 13 days passed between when we brought him to you with the first symptoms and the day he "left us," very deteriorated and in a lot of pain. LYMPHOMA. Keep that in mind for next time.
Very kind
They have very good prices and are very competent, but they are not punctual; they don't warn you when there is a delay and you can end up waiting for an hour.

We've only been going there a short time with our dog Toby, but we're delighted. Both the veterinarians and the assistants are incredibly kind, friendly, and very professional. You can tell they're passionate about their work and adore animals. As for prices, they're the cheapest I've seen at a vet in Valencia, which is a huge plus. We have complete confidence in them.

I took my cat Ragast to the vet because of a respiratory problem that none of the other veterinarians I'd seen had been able to diagnose. They immediately ran the necessary tests and gave me a diagnosis within a few days. Now my cat is on treatment and is finally improving. They are excellent professionals with a wonderful, friendly approach from both the veterinarians and the assistants. We are very happy with them.

From the very first moment, the staff was incredibly kind, professional, and attentive to both my pet and me. They always took the time to explain everything clearly, answer my questions, and make sure my furry friend was comfortable. …
We went to get our dog's teeth cleaned on the recommendation of an acquaintance, as the clinic we usually went to was much more expensive. …
Clinic with poor clinical judgment, cold treatment and lack of experience.
I HAVE NOTHING MORE TO ADD, HE IS THE BEST VETERINARIAN THAT HAS EVER HAD, IS, AND EVER WILL BE IN VALENCIA AND IN ALL OF SPAIN.

I've been going there for years, the service is excellent, and the empathy everyone has for animals and people is wonderful.
I'm so happy to take my furry friends there; I know they're in good hands, and I …
Excellent service!
Excellent service and reasonable prices
